notes: Repository is archived; exact commit is pinned for reproducibility.
The uploaded running-kernel configuration is byte-for-byte identical to arch/arm64/configs/a04e_defconfig at the pinned source branch.
This validates the defconfig match, not postmarketOS bootability or compatibility with current Alpine toolchains.
The defconfig and kernel source remain Android vendor-kernel inputs requiring postmarketOS adaptation.
No boot image or partition layout assumptions are made.
The additional a04e_00_defconfig exists but is not selected.

prebuilt_kernel_artifact.note: Exact successful kernel build output; package build must fetch and verify this artifact, not compile Image.gz again.

notes: No verified MT6765/A04e mainline device tree or bootable configuration has been established.
Do not treat a generic mainline kernel build as bootable on this handset.
README explicitly lists MT6765/MT6768 support and Linux 4.19.x compatibility.
The root Makefile selects CONNAC, HIF=axi, WLAN_CHIP_ID=6765, MTK_ANDROID_WMT and the MT6631 FM path from CONFIG_MTK_COMBO_CHIP_CONSYS_6765.
Bluetooth WMT char-device transport is included; a BlueZ HCI interface is not yet proven by this source tree.
Matching proprietary firmware blobs are not redistributed and must be extracted from the user's stock SM-A042F vendor image.
